name: On-demand bus
description: Demand-responsive transport drawn with the service zone kit: outline a zone, set the requests an hour, the fleet and the service hours, and get the vehicles needed, the average wait, ride and door-to-door time from continuous-approximation formulas. Simulate the day dispatches every booking trip by trip (ADR-0041). The zone shows in the journey planner.

tools.hint: Minibuses booked by app: outline the zone, set the fleet and hours.
